description: A picture or graphic as a slightly tilted card with a shadow on a textured background (crumpled paper, grid paper, cardboard or charcoal). Pass the previous card as 'under' to make cards stack like a pile.

fields.img: The card: any picture or an existing 1920x1080 graphic
fields.under: Optional previous card, shown behind this one at a different angle (stacking effect)
fields.texture: paper (default, crumpled), grid, cardboard or charcoal
fields.scale: Card width as % of the frame (default 74)
fields.caption: Optional big outlined caption at the bottom, *word* = highlight
fields.color: Highlight color for *words* (hex, default brand accent)
fields.seed: Texture variation number (default 3). Change it so repeated backgrounds don't look identical
